mod.overview: Beginner Mod (Dustin Bruce, August-November 2003) splits stock Base items cleanly into Weapons/, BackPacks/, Deployables/, Misc/, Turrets/, and ArmorData/ folders with Special_Functs.cs helper macros as a starter modder's template.
notes: Preserves stock Base weapon, pack, and deployable stats while reorganizing datablock definitions per file and wiring armor registration through Special_Functs.cs.
